thread:
Hannah: quick bring-up for mercator13b (candidate for chat + summarization). ran int8, int6 (AWQ), and int4-GPTQ microbench + 12k GTN slice. TL;DR: int6 is a solid cost/quality pivot; int4 gives big savings but hits multi-doc & chain-of-thought. posting numbers + proposed routing.

Hannah: perf (prod-like sample, batch=1, seq=1200):
```
int8  : tp 11.2 req/s, p50 46ms, p95 170ms, p99 380ms, cost ~$0.031 / 1k tokens
int6  : tp 9.8  req/s, p50 52ms, p95 205ms, p99 430ms, cost ~$0.023 / 1k tokens
int4  : tp 18.6 req/s, p50 30ms, p95 100ms, p99 240ms, cost ~$0.015 / 1k tokens
fp16  : tp 8.1  req/s, p50 72ms, p95 260ms, p99 610ms, cost ~$0.054 / 1k tokens
```

Hannah: quality (GTN 12k focused: chat, multi-doc summaries, rerank):
- fp16 baseline ROUGE-L 0.442
- int8 ROUGE-L 0.437 (-0.5 pts)
- int6 ROUGE-L 0.428 (-1.4 pts)
- int4 ROUGE-L 0.404 (-3.8 pts)

Jae: unit-econ quick calc (assume 1.7k tokens/request): int8 ~$0.053/req, int6 ~$0.040/req, int4 ~$0.026/req. Moving 40% -> int6 saves ~ $5.6k / 100k reqs vs fp16.

Rina: product: where does the delta matter?

Hannah: mainly multi-doc merges & stepwise reasoning. single-turn Q&A and short replies have near-zero delta.

Omar: ops: int4 shows sporadic token misalign under long-tail contexts (ticket ML-1512). int6 shows occasional p99 spikes under burst; added retry/fallback counters. Recommend pinning int8 for any route touching multi-doc merges.

Rina: ok. propose routing by intent + tier. cheap tier gets aggressive quant with filters; standard tier favors int6; premium pinned to int8/fp16. Example snippet below.

Hannah: routing snippet (example):
```json
{"model":"mercator13b","routes":{
  "summaries":{"int8":1.0},
  "chat-short":{"int6":0.8,"int8":0.2},
  "cheap-complete":{"int4":0.9,"int6":0.1}
},"fallback":"int8","canary_samples":6000}
```

Jae: GTN gating (48h smoke): ROUGE-L drop <=1.2 pts absolute on summary slice, p99 latency <=450ms, client error rate <=0.2%. For cheap-complete route allow ROUGE-L drop up to 2.2 pts if postfilter false-positive rate <0.6%. Fail -> rollback.

Hannah: mitigation paths:
- mixed-decode (prefix int6, decode int8) recovered ~0.7 ROUGE pts in bench; infra cost moderate.
- short quant-finetune (3k steps) expected to recover ~0.8-1.2 pts for int6; ~2.0-2.5 pts for int4 on single-doc slices. estimate ~3 TPU-days.

Omar: ops checklist before canary: KV-cache alignment patch (PR#623), shadow traffic 6h, increase canary quota, add monitors: rouge-l by slice, fallback-counts, postfilter-fails. scheduling tentative canary 2025-03-21T02:00Z.

Rina: decision recs for GTN/docs:
- immediate: allow int6 for chat-short (canary 50%) and pin int8 for summaries and rerank.
- short-term: enable int4 only for internal cheap-complete beta with postfilter + shadowing.
- medium-term: run quant-finetune + mixed-decode; re-evaluate with 50k-sample product-signal eval.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: mercator13b-int6 -> 2025-03-21T02:00Z, samples=6000, owner=Omar. Monitoring: rouge-l, latency, errors, fallback-counts.

Jae: I'll own the 50k slice eval and coordinate with product on signals. ETA 72h.

Hannah: thanks all. summary: int6 = cost/quality sweet spot for many chat flows; int4 only for gated cheap workloads with filtering and further calibration. will draft GTN note and slides. :thumbsup:
